title: Ticketing status (bookings.ticketing_status, the API's IssuanceStatus)
caption: Driven by storefront_settings.ticketing_policy (issue_after_payment default, issue_at_booking, manual_review), the ticketing job (ticketing.scan every 5 min, ticketing.issue on ota-ticketing) and console.bookings.issue (src/bookings/ticketing.service.ts, ticketing-schedule.ts).

states.label: pending
states.detail: Default at insert; `ticketing_next_attempt_at` set when the job should try.

states.label: in_progress
states.detail: A claim: the job or a staff issuance holds it; cancellations wait (`409 BOOKING_NOT_MODIFIABLE ticketing_in_progress`).

states.label: failed
states.detail: Last attempt failed (`ticketing_error_code`, `ticketing_attempts`). ticketing-schedule.ts retries 5 min, 15 min, 1 h, then every 2 h, at most 8 attempts, none later than the deadline − 2 h, none after PAYMENT_DECLINED. When no attempt is left: staff alert `staff.ticketing_failed` and traveller e-mail `booking.ticketing_delayed` (once each); the status stays failed.

states.label: manual_review
states.detail: Staff must act: policy manual_review, capture failed, airline-card order without every ticket, reconciliation undecided, PNR import of an unticketed order. The ticketing job never takes it.

states.label: not_applicable
states.detail: Failed booking, or cancelled before issuance.

transitions.label: claim (checkout issue step / ticketing job / staff)
booking failed or cancelled before issuance
order came back with tickets (issue=true, airline card, import)
